text.name: Douli of the Prophet
text.description:
{Douli of the Prophet}

Worn on the head, this item increases your Defense and Knowledge skills by +3, and helps you recover 10% of your maximum spell points per day.
text.event: An old hat lays before you, sitting alone on a rocky outcropping. You can feel its arcane power from where you stand; you can sense the hat calling to you. You take the hat from where it sits, dust it off, and put it in your backpack.
